name: talk-and-taste
description: Local-first bilingual cafe POS and management system

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c '#8b6657,#c89160' 'npm run dev -w @token-taste/api' 'npm run dev -w @token-taste/web'
scripts.build: npm run build -w @token-taste/shared && npm run build -w @token-taste/api && npm run build -w @token-taste/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @token-taste/api && npm run test -w @token-taste/web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run verify:first-run && npm run verify:integration
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @token-taste/shared && npm run typecheck -w @token-taste/api && npm run typecheck -w @token-taste/web
